# Management scenarios (generated by `pixi run compare`)

Instance development_medium. Every plan comes from the unchanged LNS run on a planning copy with tighter internal targets, then is checked by the independent checker on the real input files and executed unchanged under the 30 saved stress scenarios (base: day factor mean 1.0, CV 0.2; heavy: mean 1.15, CV 0.3). Driver hours count from shift start to return; the just-in-time column subtracts the wait at each route's first stop, which changes no service time.
